name: kynorix
description: Kynorix modular event exchange platform — sandbox-first.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @kynorix/api && npm run build -w @kynorix/web && npm run build -w @kynorix/admin && npm run build -w @kynorix/mobile
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @kynorix/contracts && npm run build -w @kynorix/core && npm run build -w @kynorix/database
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @kynorix/api" "npm run dev -w @kynorix/web" "npm run dev -w @kynorix/admin"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run db:migrations:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
